If I could change the world in one way, I’d make empathy universal—not just sympathy, but the deep ability to understand and feel others’ experiences.

So many of the world’s biggest problems—war, inequality, discrimination, cruelty—depend on seeing people as “other.” If that divide were harder to maintain, many other changes would follow naturally: fairer systems, less violence, more cooperation, and a stronger sense of shared responsibility.
